title: Detective Dee
blurb: Tsui Hark's wuxia mysteries in Tang dynasty China: one adventure with an older Dee, then two prequels about his early career.

dee10.t: Detective Dee and the Mystery of the Phantom Flame

dee13.t: Young Detective Dee: Rise of the Sea Dragon

dee18.t: Detective Dee: The Four Heavenly Kings

note: The two prequels form a pair, so either watch them first for a straight line or save them for after the original. Nothing is spoiled either way.
